title: Match the RAG failure to the fix

prompts.text: The answer is in the corpus, but the right chunk is never among the retrieved ones
The right chunk is in the prompt, but the answer contradicts it
A user receives content from a document they are not allowed to open
Answers describe a policy that changed last week
Searches for error code "E-4012" return unrelated pages

options.text: Instruct the model to answer only from the context with citations, and check faithfulness
Fine-tune the model on the whole corpus every night
Add keyword (BM25) retrieval and fuse it with vector search
Improve retrieval: hybrid search, better chunking, query rewriting; measure recall@k
Filter by the user's permissions inside the retrieval query
Re-index changed documents incrementally and prefer recent versions
